description:
Tiny native Discord app

Dissent (previously gtkcord4) is a third-party Discord client designed for a smooth, native experience on Linux desktops.
Built with the GTK4 and libadwaita for a modern look and feel, it delivers your favorite Discord app in a lightweight and visually appealing package.
New Features
- Replaced the email/token login screen with a Libadwaita greeter, token dialog, and ephemeral WebKitGTK 6.0 Discord login flow (including QR code login)
- Added browser TLS fingerprinting (uTLS), correlated browser headers, and X-Super-Properties for HTTP and gateway requests (#343)
- Automatically mark the session as AFK after the Away Timeout or when the screensaver turns on so push notifications reach mobile devices
- Reworked the media viewer with pinch/scroll/double-click zoom, drag panning, fullscreen, and auto-hiding overlay controls
- The About dialog now lists Dissent contributors from GitHub
Fixes
- Saved tokens are now forgotten immediately when Discord closes the gateway with 4004 Authentication failed
- Collapsed message rows containing only images no longer overflow their row height, and message rows now have right padding away from the scrollbar
- Embed images and attachments are fetched at their displayed size within Discord's 4096px proxy limit
- Channel category fold state and selected channel are preserved across guild switches and list updates
Full Changelog: https://github.com/diamondburned/dissent/compare/v0.0.41...v0.0.50
